verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 7 258V is a physical processor that the buyer already owns and runs on their own device. 'Self-hosting the core product' is a software/SaaS deployment axis, so it is a category error for a CPU. Evidence about running AI locally on the chip describes a different capability, not self-hosting of the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
